# TimiCY

> TimiCY is a free price-comparison website for the Cypriot electronics market. It tracks prices across six local retailers — iStorm, Kotsovolos, Stephanis, Electroline, Public, and Bionic — covering 21 product categories, with daily price updates and per-product price history.

TimiCY does not sell products. Every product page lists the current price at each store with a direct link to the retailer, marks availability per store, and shows the historical lowest-price trend. Prices are in EUR. The site is available in Greek (default) and English; Greek pages live under /el/ and English pages under /en/.

## Main pages

- [Homepage (Greek)](https://timicy.com/el): Search and category entry point
- [Homepage (English)](https://timicy.com/en): English-language version
